notes: 🌱 Climbers Today rows are now two lines by design. On a phone the row's fixed parts — number, code, odds chip, price and strength — already fill the width, so the share name and signals were being squeezed into a one-word-per-line sliver (and the v760 word-breaking made it worse, splitting words mid-way). Each row now puts number, code, chip, price and strength on the first line, with the name and its strongest climbing line on a full-width second line. Nothing about the ranking or the (+N more — hold to see) list changed.
